metadata.title: VIDS Compliance Analysis: Four Public Medical Imaging Datasets

scoring.partial_definition: Information is present in the dataset but not in a machine-readable or standardized form (e.g., provenance described in a companion paper but absent from the dataset files).

dimensions.description: Machine-readable file identifying the dataset as conforming to a standard and declaring the compliance profile.
Structured metadata file with dataset name, version, license, description, and authors in machine-readable format.
Structured file listing all subjects with demographics and inclusion criteria.
Plain-language description of the dataset, its contents, and usage instructions.
Consistent per-subject directory structure with standardized naming.
Per-session directory nesting within each subject.
Imaging data stored in NIfTI format with valid affine transformation.
Structured JSON sidecar per imaging file documenting acquisition parameters, source format, and quality assessment.
All imaging files follow a standardized naming convention encoding subject, session, and modality.
Annotations stored in a dedicated directory tree mirroring the source imaging layout.
Segmentation annotations provided as volumetric mask files with integer class labels.
Structured JSON sidecar per annotation file documenting annotation type, source image, and label map.
Mapping of integer voxel values to class names provided in structured format.
Each annotation documents the identity (name or ID) of the annotator.
Each annotation documents the qualifications and experience of the annotator.
Each annotation documents the software tool and version used.
Each annotation documents the date it was created.
Each annotation documents whether quality control review was performed, by whom, and the outcome.
Dataset includes structured documentation of agreement metrics (e.g., Dice coefficient) between annotators.
Dataset includes a structured quality summary with annotation statistics, QC pass rates, and certification.
Train/validation/test splits provided in structured format.
Documentation of split strategy, random seed, leakage prevention, and rationale.
